facts.function: casing accessories: float collar and float shoe control cement and fluid flow in the casing string
facts.end_use: downhole drilling of oil and gas wells

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8431 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with machinery of headings 8425-8430; Section XVI note 2(b) puts such identifiable parts in 8431
GRI 6: 8431.43 parts for boring or sinking machinery of 8430.41/8430.49; 8431.43.80 Other; 8431.43.80.60 Other

rejected_alternatives.reason: other articles of iron or steel; H319171 addressed this competing heading for casing accessories and the protestant relied on float collars in 8431
casing tubes themselves; float collars and shoes are fittings, not tubes
limited to parts of offshore drilling and production platforms; not stated
parts of other boring or sinking machinery; oil well drilling falls under 8430.41/49 lines

missing_facts: Material and whether used offshore (would change to 8431.43.40.00)
classification.rationale: Float collars and shoes are casing-string components used in oil and gas well drilling. H319171 (centralizers and stop collars, 8431.43.80) describes the same heading-8431-versus-7326 question and records that float collars and shoes were classified under 8431 in a prior HQ ruling, which was not retrievable from the corpus. The catch-all 8431.43.80.60 is used.
